messages:
Rae (People Ops): Quick heads-up — were publishing a short final-week surge handbook for reviewers who volunteer for extra coverage. It covers overtime pay, TOIL rules, sign-up, and calibration priorities. Link: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/surge-handbook

Jon: Clarify pay vs TOIL? Some reviewers prefer time off rather than pay.

Rae (People Ops): Official policy for this cycle: approved surge hours are paid at 1.5x. Managers can request TOIL instead only for non-exempt hourly reviewers and it needs manager + payroll signoff. Always pre-approve on the surge sheet before work begins. Timesheet link: https://redwood.internal/payroll/timesheet

Mira: How do we avoid burning the same reviewers for calibration sampling? Last-minute surges skewed sampling last time.

Rae (People Ops): Good point. Please tag any review you pick up with comment: "surge: volunteer" and add label "surge-priority" in the form. Ops will rotate volunteers and sampling will upweight surge-reviewed items rather than re-sampling the same folks. Also please keep volunteer load <= 6h extra/week where possible.

Devon: If we hit the 6h cap and still have backlog, should we reassign or keep asking volunteers?

Rae (People Ops): Reassign first (use fallback rota). If reassign impossible, escalate to @HeadPeopleOps for temporary capacity. No one should exceed the 6h cap without explicit exec approval.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: "Surge sign-up window closes in 12h."

HR-payroll-bot: Payroll note: payroll cutoff for surge pay is Wed 23:59 PT. Any paid overtime must be in the timesheet by cutoff to appear in this cycle's payroll.

Jon: Will we run a mini-calibration for items processed during surge?

Rae (People Ops): Yes, surge-reviewed items are added to a prioritized calibration batch. Tag with "surge" so the sampling script picks them up. No rubric changes mid-cycle.

Mira: Thanks 44d I'll DM the list of volunteers and their availability.

Rae (People Ops): Perfect — I'll post the 1-pager + links in #people-ops-resources in ~15m. If anyone needs a quick exception, DM me directly.
